name: Is it better to repair or replace a severely warped water-damaged door?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to repair or replace a severely warped water-damaged door?

acceptedAnswer.text: When a door is severely warped due to water damage, replacement is almost always a better long-term solution than repair. Warping indicates significant structural changes that are difficult to fully reverse, often leading to poor sealing, drafts, and security issues. While repair might offer a temporary fix, a new door ensures proper fit, energy efficiency, and a clean aesthetic. We help homeowners in areas like West Boise and West Downtown make this comparison based on their specific situation and budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: For severely warped water-damaged doors, replacement is generally better than repair due to structural issues affecting fit, sealing, and security. A new door ensures proper function and efficiency.
